secret_reference_policy: Use same-project whatsapp.DATABASE_URL and whatsapp.INTERNAL_SECRET references; never read, copy or rotate their values.
routing_policy: Preserve WORKER_ROUTES_JSON exactly. Add the six new private-domain/PORT references using SHARED_WORKER_ROUTES_JSON and declare only these six groups in SHARED_WORKER_GROUPS_JSON after independent volumes and healthy workers exist. Duplicate legacy group keys fail closed.
activation_policy: Owner alone registers, connects and scans shared accounts. USERs may only submit their own consented sends. Do not auto-enable shared sending or change pricing.
quota_approval: Railway support confirmed the project volume limit was increased to 27 on 2026-10-18. Creation of six new independent 10GB volumes succeeded.
connection_budget: Each worker keeps one pool connection for its ownership lock, so DB_POOL_SIZE=1 cannot start. Six pools of two plus the unchanged 72 personal-worker connections and API pool 10 yield ceiling 94; do not change PostgreSQL settings or existing workers.
next_action: Owner may create a shared account using Add account / Automatic allocation and link a real phone. Counters use live database heartbeats, not this historical verification snapshot. No production phone login or customer message was used as a test.
